{{Quote|K-Kobal's World? How could '''you''' know about... about... Oh Lord. Those children, I killed them...|A stormtrooper recalls events on Kobal's World|<ref name="DLC" />}}
After the [[Declaration of a New Order|proclamation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet [[Kobal's World/Legends|Kobal's World]],<ref name="DLC" /> located in the [[Koradin sector/Legends|far sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], '''became''' the site of a significant Imperial atrocity that resulted in extensive civilian casualties,<ref name="EA" /> including the slaughter of a number of [[Gender/Legends|women]] and [[Youngling/Legends|children]] by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. One of those stormtroopers later [[Mission to Cheelit|accompanied]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Cheelit/Legends|Cheelit]], where the [[Guild of Vindicators]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Clat]] the Shamer used the [[Memory Walk|memories to compel]] the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to commit [[Death/Legends|suicide]].<ref name="DLC" />
